caption: Figure 1. Overview of UNETR. Our proposed model consists of a transformer encoder that directly utilizes 3D patches and is connected to a CNN-based decoder via skip connection.

Figure 2. Overview of UNETR architecture. A 3D input volume (e.g. C =4 channels for MRI images), is divided into a sequence of uniform non-overlapping patches and projected into an embedding space using a linear layer.
